$comment: Sample comments for posts. Applied by scripts/seed-comments.mjs after `emdash seed` — the emdash seed format has no native comment support, so these live in their own file.

items.name: Mara Ellingsen
items.body: The bit about letting one photograph carry the whole spread finally gave me permission to cut three images I had been defending for weeks. Thank you for putting words to that instinct.

items.name: Rafael Ocampo
items.body: Curious how you handle horizontal panoramas here — they never seem to earn their width in a two-column grid.

replies.name: Hermion Laurent
replies.body: Usually I crop them to 21:9 and give them the full row, like the featured treatment on the index. A panorama that has to share a column is a panorama that has already lost.

items.name: June Park
items.body: "Restraint is not the absence of ideas, it is the presence of judgment." Putting this above my desk.

items.name: Tomas Verner
items.body: We shipped a client site last month after deleting almost half of what we had designed. It tested better than any version before it. This piece describes exactly why.

items.name: Priya Raghavan
items.body: The comparison to a well-lit reading room is the best argument for calm software I have read. Screens can be rooms too.

items.name: Daniel Okafor
items.body: Quiet does not mean lifeless, and this piece gets that distinction right. Motion should feel like someone breathing, not someone tapping the glass.

items.name: Lina Fischer
items.body: Subscribed. Looking forward to notes on process rather than another feed of polished end results.
